about.title: About CYNA
about.article: Founded in 2021 following emergency responses to major cyberattacks, Cyna is a French managed cybersecurity company that designs and operates cutting-edge sovereign solutions, including SOC, EDR, and XDR.
about.article2: Historically marketed through a direct distribution network, its services are now entering a new era with the launch of an innovative e-commerce platform designed to simplify access to its subscriptions on an international scale.
about.article3: Tailored to pragmatically meet the needs of SMEs, mid-caps, and managed service providers (MSPs), Cyna's solutions rely on a highly secure infrastructure, data hosting based exclusively in France, and an elite team of experts providing continuous proactive surveillance 24/7.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.paragraph1: The purpose of this document is to define the conditions for accessing and using the CYNA-IT e-commerce platform. Accessing the catalog and subscribing to our SaaS services implies full and unreserved acceptance of these terms by the user.
terms.subtitle2: Access to SaaS Services and Account Creation
terms.paragraph2: Access to certain features, including purchasing subscriptions, managing the cart, and viewing order history, requires the creation of a secure user account. The user agrees to provide accurate information, maintain the confidentiality of their login credentials, and report any unauthorized use of their account.
terms.paragraph3: All content, trademarks, logos, graphics, source codes, and architectures of the software solutions (SOC, EDR, XDR) featured on this website are the exclusive property of CYNA-IT. Any unauthorized reproduction, modification, or distribution of these elements is strictly prohibited and will be subject to legal action.
terms.paragraph4: Pricing, billing, and automatic renewal terms for SaaS services are detailed during the cart validation process. Financial transactions are processed in an encrypted manner through secure, certified payment gateways.
terms.paragraph5: CYNA-IT makes every effort to ensure continuous access to its e-commerce platform and support tools, such as the Chatbot. However, the company reserves the right to temporarily suspend access to the website for technical maintenance or updates, without any entitlement to compensation.
terms.paragraph6: The user is solely responsible for their use of the information provided on the website and for the security of their own computer equipment. CYNA-IT shall not be held liable for any indirect damages, data loss, or service interruptions caused by a force majeure event or an Internet network malfunction.
terms.subtitle7: Modifications to Terms and Applicable Law
terms.paragraph7: CYNA-IT reserves the right to modify these terms at any time to adapt to technical or legal changes. These terms are governed by French law, and any dispute shall be submitted to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Paris.
